name: Build tooling
purpose: Scripts a developer runs outside the application to prepare it for compiling.

name: Policy definitions and data model
purpose: Reads policy definition and comment files, resolves their references and holds the result in memory for the screens.

name: Settings and configuration
purpose: Keeps the program's own choices in the current user's registry and pins the runtime version the program runs on.

name: Screens
purpose: What a person sees and enters: Windows Forms windows and dialogs, their layout, the handlers that react to a person using them, and the small value shapes dialogs fill in and hand back to the main window.

name: Policy state logic and Windows interop
purpose: Decides which state each policy is in, reads and writes policy sources (POL files, REG files, the registry), parses policy-state scripts, and wraps Windows system calls, edition checks and privileges.

name: Screen event handler
membershipRule: A Sub in a form's hand-written file (X.vb, not *.Designer.vb) whose declaration ends in a Handles clause naming a control or form event, which a person triggers. A form's other procedures belong to the screen helper kind.

name: Screen helper routine
membershipRule: A Sub or Function without a Handles clause in a form's hand-written file (X.vb), called by other code to show or fill the form: dialog entry points (PresentDialog), list refreshers, selection helpers and validators. Handlers with a Handles clause belong to the screen event handler kind; overrides of a control subclass belong to the custom control procedure kind.

name: Generated screen layout routine
membershipRule: A procedure inside a *.Designer.vb file marked DesignerGenerated, such as InitializeComponent, which builds and positions the controls, and Dispose. Control declarations belong to the screen layout declaration kind.

name: Screen layout declaration
membershipRule: The Friend WithEvents control declarations at the end of a *.Designer.vb partial class, with the captions and limits InitializeComponent sets for those controls.

name: Custom control or helper class procedure
membershipRule: An override or method of a small class declared beside a form (a control subclass or a nested helper class) rather than of the form itself, such as WndProc or ToString.

name: Build script
membershipRule: A Windows batch file (.bat) a developer runs by hand to prepare the build; code that runs inside the application belongs to a Visual Basic kind instead.

name: Policy data routine
membershipRule: A method of a non-form class or module that reads, writes, resolves or converts policy definition, comment or load-failure data (AdmxFile, AdmlFile, CmtxFile, AdmxBundle and the failure class). Form procedures belong to the screen kinds.

name: Settings storage routine
membershipRule: A method of the class that opens and reads or writes the program's own registry key for saved choices.

name: Runtime configuration file
membershipRule: An App.config XML file that pins the runtime version the program starts on.

name: Windows function declaration
membershipRule: A Declare statement in PInvoke.vb that names a function in a Windows system library and has no body; code elsewhere calls it as PInvoke.Name. Bodies written in Visual Basic belong to the other routine kinds.

name: Policy source loader routine
membershipRule: A method or property of the PolicyLoader class that opens, mounts, saves or describes a policy source (a POL file, a registry key or a mounted NTUSER.DAT hive) and keeps its gpt.ini version in step; routines that decide policy states or read and write the source contents belong to the policy logic kind.

name: Policy logic routine
membershipRule: A method, property or bodiless interface member of the non-form classes PolicyProcessing, IPolicySource, PolFile, RegistryPolicyProxy, RegFile and Privilege, or of the small classes nested in them, that decides a policy state, reads or writes a policy source (POL file, REG file or Registry), or enables a Windows privilege. Windows function declarations belong to their own kind; plain field-only classes belong to Data class.

name: Windows environment check routine
membershipRule: A hand-written method of a module that asks Windows about the machine the program runs on (for example its edition) and returns a yes or no; policy data routines and screen routines belong to their own kinds.

name: Dialog hand-over data class
membershipRule: A Class, Structure or enumeration declared in a form's file or beside it that holds only fixed fields or named values and exists to carry a dialog's choices or a form's own rows, such as FilterConfiguration passed to the main window or the form-private PolValueInfo. Classes that hold values read from policy definition files, such as AdmxProduct, belong to the policy data class kind.

name: Policy state script routine
membershipRule: A method of SpolFile or SpolPolicyState that parses policy-state script text (SPOL) into policy states, writes a state back as script text, or applies the states to a policy source. Methods of other policy classes belong to the policy logic routine kind.

name: Policy data class
membershipRule: A plain class, structure or enumeration, or the field part of a class, that only holds values read from policy definition files or built from them (AdmxProduct, AdmxProductType), with no screen controls. Dialog hand-over shapes belong to the dialog hand-over data class kind. Its methods are separate blocks of the policy data routine kind.

name: Microsoft Download Center
reachedBy: The ADMX download dialog fetches an MSI package over HTTPS with the .NET WebClient.
membershipRule: The URL held in constant MicrosoftMsiDownloadLink (https://download.microsoft.com/...), fetched with Net.WebClient.DownloadFile.

name: Windows Installer (msiexec)
reachedBy: The program starts the msiexec process to unpack the downloaded MSI into a folder.
membershipRule: A Process.Start of msiexec with arguments /a, /quiet, /qn and TARGETDIR.

name: Windows system libraries
reachedBy: The program declares functions of user32, userenv, advapi32 and kernel32 with Declare statements and calls them directly.
membershipRule: Every Declare Lib statement in PInvoke.vb; the resource is the function name as declared.

name: Windows registry
reachedBy: The .NET registry classes open a hive (current user, users, local machine) and read, write or delete values under the policy keys, the program's own settings key, and a hive file mounted by the program.
membershipRule: Every RegistryKey call: OpenBaseKey of any RegistryHive, OpenSubKey, CreateSubKey, GetValue, SetValue and DeleteValue; the resource is the key path. Loading and unloading a hive file with RegLoadKeyW and RegUnLoadKeyW is a call to the Windows system libraries entry, not this one.

name: Local file system, including policy definition and comment files
reachedBy: Direct .NET System.IO and XmlDocument calls on local folders and files: ADMX, ADML and CMTX policy files and their folders, POL, REG, SPOL and NTUSER.DAT files, Registry.pol and gpt.ini under the Group Policy folders, the scratch folder under %localappdata% and the destination folder the person picks.
membershipRule: Any System.IO (File, Directory, FileStream, StreamReader, StreamWriter, access-control calls) or XmlDocument Load or Save of a local path; the resource is the folder or file path. Covers ADMX and ADML loads and folder enumeration, CMTX saves under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Policy Plus, POL files, Registry.pol and gpt.ini under %SYSTEMROOT%\System32\GroupPolicy and GroupPolicyUsers, NTUSER.DAT under C:\Users, .reg and SPOL text files, %localappdata%\PolicyPlusAdmxDownload and the picked destination folder.

name: Windows Forms and .NET class library
reachedBy: Dialogs call framework user-interface members to show windows, message boxes and file pickers, and override control base-class members; there is no source for them in scope.
membershipRule: Calls to the user-interface members only: ShowDialog, MsgBox, SaveFileDialog, OpenFileDialog, FolderBrowserDialog, Clipboard and control base-class overrides such as TreeView.WndProc (FilterOptions.vb 155-157); the resource is the member called. Calls reaching the registry, the file system, the network, the account database or another process belong to those entries, not this one.

name: Windows account database
reachedBy: The program asks Windows to translate an account name to a security identifier, who the current user is, whether they are an administrator, and builds security identifiers, with the .NET System.Security.Principal classes.
membershipRule: Every way the code asks Windows about accounts and identifiers: NTAccount.Translate, WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent, WindowsPrincipal.IsInRole and SecurityIdentifier construction; the resource is the account name or SID.

name: Build tooling
purpose: Scripts a developer runs outside the application to prepare it for compiling.

name: Build script
membershipRule: A Windows batch file (.bat) a developer runs by hand to prepare the build; code that runs inside the application belongs to a Visual Basic kind instead.

name: Generated version source file
reachedBy: Redirected echo output written to PolicyPlus\Version.vb, which is not among the analysed files.
membershipRule: The path held in variable VF in version.bat (PolicyPlus\Version.vb).

name: Git command line
reachedBy: The batch file runs the git program from the developer shell.
membershipRule: The command git describe --always run from version.bat.

membershipRule: RegistryKey.OpenBaseKey, CreateSubKey, GetValue and SetValue calls; resource is the subkey the caller names.

name: Screens

name: Form handler code
membershipRule: A Sub or Function in the hand-written half of a Windows Forms form class (Public Class X in X.vb, with Inherits supplied by X.Designer.vb), including Handles-clause event handlers and the form's own methods; the generated half belongs to Generated screen layout builder.

name: Generated screen layout builder
membershipRule: A Sub in a X.Designer.vb file (InitializeComponent, Dispose) generated by the Windows Forms designer that creates, sets and disposes a form's controls; never an entry point.

name: Screen layout
membershipRule: The Friend WithEvents control declarations at the end of a X.Designer.vb file (with the captions and limits InitializeComponent sets for them), one definition per form class.

name: Microsoft Download Center
reachedBy: The ADMX download dialog fetches an MSI package over HTTPS with the .NET WebClient.
membershipRule: The URL held in constant MicrosoftMsiDownloadLink (https://download.microsoft.com/...), fetched with Net.WebClient.DownloadFile.

name: Local file system
reachedBy: Direct .NET IO.Directory, IO.File and access-control calls on local folders such as the scratch folder under %localappdata% and the chosen destination folder.
membershipRule: Paths under %localappdata%\PolicyPlusAdmxDownload and the destination folder the person picks, reached through System.IO.

name: What a person sees and enters
purpose: The windows and dialogs a person works in, with the handlers that react to what they click or type.

name: Policy data and logic
purpose: Plain in-memory data classes and routines that hold and process policy values.

name: Screen layout definition
membershipRule: The controls a Windows Forms screen declares: the Friend WithEvents control fields at the end of a form's .Designer.vb file, with the captions and limits set in its InitializeComponent. One definition per screen.

name: Generated screen layout builder
membershipRule: Routines in a form's .Designer.vb file marked DesignerGenerated: InitializeComponent, which creates and positions the controls, and Dispose, which cleans them up. Handwritten form code belongs to a form handler or routine instead.

name: Form event handler
membershipRule: A Sub in a handwritten form file whose declaration ends in a Handles clause naming a control or form event; a person triggers it. A Sub without Handles is a form routine.

name: Form routine
membershipRule: A Sub or Function without a Handles clause in a form class or a control subclass: dialog entry points (PresentDialog), list refreshers, selection helpers, validators and control overrides.

name: Data class
membershipRule: A Class or Structure holding only fields, with no members that run, declared inside another class or on its own.

name: What a person sees and enters
purpose: Dialog windows that show policy data and let a person set options, search or export, with the handlers that react to their actions.

name: Working data
purpose: Small in-memory shapes that dialogs fill in and hand back to the main window, such as the filter settings.

name: Dialog procedure
membershipRule: A Sub or Function, or an anonymous handler, in the hand-written half of a Windows Forms form class (a Public Class X in X.vb that has a designer partner); includes Handles-bound event handlers, PresentDialog entry methods and helpers. Generated designer code and custom control overrides belong to other kinds.

name: Custom control or helper class procedure
membershipRule: An override or method of a small class declared beside a form (a control subclass or a nested helper class) rather than of the form itself, such as WndProc or ToString.

name: Generated screen layout routine
membershipRule: The InitializeComponent and Dispose procedures in a form X.Designer.vb file, marked DesignerGenerated or DebuggerStepThrough; they build or release the controls and hold no hand-written behaviour.

name: Screen layout
membershipRule: The Friend WithEvents control declarations of a form in X.Designer.vb, together with the captions and limits its InitializeComponent sets; one per form.

name: Working data class
membershipRule: A plain class or enumeration that only holds fixed fields or named values and is passed between dialogs and the main window, e.g. FilterConfiguration; a nested class with only fields is included.

name: Windows Forms and .NET class library
reachedBy: Dialogs call framework members to show windows, pop up message boxes and ask for a save path; there is no source for them in scope.
membershipRule: Calls to ShowDialog, MsgBox, SaveFileDialog and base-class members such as TreeView.WndProc; the resource is the member called.

name: Windows function declaration
membershipRule: A Declare statement in PInvoke.vb that names a function in a Windows system library and has no body; code elsewhere calls it as PInvoke.Name. Bodies written in Visual Basic belong to the other routine kinds.

name: Policy source loader routine
membershipRule: A method or property of the PolicyLoader class that opens, mounts, saves or describes a policy source (a POL file, a registry key or a mounted NTUSER.DAT hive) and keeps its gpt.ini version in step; routines that decide policy states or read and write the source contents belong to the policy logic kind.

name: Windows system libraries
reachedBy: The program declares functions of user32, userenv, advapi32 and kernel32 with Declare statements and calls them directly.
membershipRule: Every Declare Lib statement in PInvoke.vb; the resource is the function name as declared.

name: Windows account database
reachedBy: The user dialog asks Windows to translate an account name to its security identifier with the .NET NTAccount class.
membershipRule: NTAccount.Translate to SecurityIdentifier in OpenUserGpo.vb; the resource is the account name typed by the person.

name: Policy logic routine
membershipRule: A method, property or bodiless interface member of the non-form classes PolicyProcessing, IPolicySource, PolFile, RegistryPolicyProxy, RegFile and Privilege, or of the small classes nested in them, that decides a policy state, reads or writes a policy source (POL file, REG file or Registry), or enables a Windows privilege. Windows function declarations belong to their own kind; plain field-only classes belong to Data class.

name: Windows environment check routine
membershipRule: A hand-written method of a module that asks Windows about the machine the program runs on (for example its edition) and returns a yes or no; policy data routines and screen routines belong to their own kinds.

name: Policy state script routine
membershipRule: A method of a non-form class that parses or writes policy-state script text (SPOL) or applies the policy states it holds to a policy source (SpolFile, SpolPolicyState).
